## Failing tests

End-to-end CLI tests call `cli.Run` in a fresh `t.TempDir()` store (with
`t.Chdir`, which rules out `t.Parallel`, or a root option the implementer adds
and records under C32), with a fixed clock where dates matter.

- After `supersede A --by B`: A is `superseded`, A.superseded_by is B,
  B.supersedes includes A, and each gets one history entry.
- `context` no longer lists A; `show A` still prints A and its history
  (acceptance criterion).
- A not decided, B not decided, A equal to B, or an unknown ID exits non-zero
  and leaves both records unchanged.

## Implement

Load both records, apply both changes in memory and validate them, then write
both through `store.Update`. Nothing is written unless both records pass.
